tools.name: rvc_sing
tools.description: Play a song from this computer's local RVC cover library through the speakers. Use it when the person asks you to sing or play a saved song: "给我唱《起风了》", "来一首", "来首清唱". Pass song when they name a song; omit song to pick a random saved one. kind defaults to "clean" (vocals only, no backing track): only pass "cover" when the person explicitly asks for a cover or with backing track. A new call stops the previous song first. It returns as soon as playback starts — do not wait for the whole song. When the library is empty or the song is not saved, it returns an explanation; relay it instead of pretending you sang.

song.description: Song name to look up in the saved cover library. Chinese titles with 《》 are fine. Omit to play a random saved song.

kind.description: clean = vocals only (default; use unless the person explicitly wants a cover). cover = with backing track.

summary.zh: 从翻唱库按歌名或随机点一首，本机外放；默认清唱，明确要翻唱 / 带伴奏才用翻唱版。
summary.en: Plays a saved song from the local cover library through the speakers — by name or random; clean vocals by default, cover only when explicitly asked.
